## Contact & contributions

If you would like to contribute examples, report issues, or reuse the
tutorials for teaching, please contact the HYDRA-EO team or open an issue
in the relevant repositories.

---

::: {.card-grid-1}

::: {.vbl-card-1}
::: {.pill-mini}
Coordination
:::

### Project lead

Dr. **Carlos Camino** (Wageningen University) is responsible for the
overall scientific coordination of the HYDRA-EO project. His role
includes leading the development of the methodological framework,
coordinating the integration of radiative transfer modelling and hybrid
machine learning approaches, and overseeing the design and maintenance
of tutorial materials and open-source tools.

He acts as the main interface with ESA and consortium partners, ensuring
scientific coherence, timely delivery of project outputs, and alignment
with project objectives.

[Go to the Virtual Biophysical Lab](https://ccgcam.github.io/Virtual-Biophysical-Lab/)
:::
